channels.name: D+
channels.purpose: Positive data line of the D+/D- differential pair; carries NRZI-encoded packets.

channels.name: VBUS
channels.purpose: +5 V power; 4.40..5.25 V at downstream port.

logical_signaling_levels.name: SE0
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: Single-Ended Zero; used for EOP + Reset + disconnect

global_signals.name: VBUS_+5V
global_signals.purpose: Bus power supply from host or hub.

global_signals.name: GND
global_signals.purpose: Common ground for host + hubs + devices.

dependency_graph.common_rule: All transactions initiated by the host (poll-based). Devices respond when polled; they may NAK but cannot initiate non-SOF traffic (except remote-wakeup K-state).
dependency_graph.data_dependency: Each transaction is Token + (optional Data) + (optional Handshake). Data toggle bit synchronizes endpoint between host and device across retries.

handshake_pairs.name: TOKEN-DATA
handshake_pairs.rule: OUT/SETUP token followed by DATAx (host) or IN token followed by DATAx (device).

handshake_pairs.name: DATA-ACK
handshake_pairs.rule: Receiver returns ACK on successful CRC; both sides toggle their bit.

handshake_pairs.name: DATA-NAK
handshake_pairs.rule: Device returns NAK if not ready; host retries later; toggle preserved.

handshake_pairs.name: DATA-STALL
handshake_pairs.rule: Device returns STALL when endpoint is halted; host must ClearFeature(ENDPOINT_HALT).

handshake_pairs.name: DATA-NYET
handshake_pairs.rule: (HS) Device accepted but not ready for next; host PINGs before retry.

handshake_pairs.name: PING-ACK_NAK
handshake_pairs.rule: (HS) Host PINGs device endpoint; device responds ACK (ready) or NAK (not ready).

handshake_pairs.name: SSPLIT-CSPLIT
handshake_pairs.rule: Host issues Start-Split + transaction; hub responds; host issues Complete-Split to fetch result.

ordering_rules.bit_order_within_byte: LSB-first on the wire after NRZI encoding.
ordering_rules.byte_order_within_field: Little-endian for multi-byte fields (wValue, wIndex, wLength, descriptors).
ordering_rules.tx_rx_simultaneity: Half-duplex; bus turn-around between TX and RX.
